title: artifact: in-memory service shares Part pointers between save, storage and load
body:
The in-memory artifact service stores the saved `*genai.Part` by pointer and returns that same pointer from `Load` (`artifact/inmemory.go`). Changing a part after saving it, or changing a part returned by `Load`, silently rewrites the stored artifact for every later reader.

adk-python deep-copies the part on save and on load (`artifacts/in_memory_artifact_service.py`).

Fix with regression tests: #1782

---
Written with the help of an agent (Claude Code, claude-opus-5-5).
